def.note: Cut C's number. 3 damage is deliberately below anything that threatens the line_tank's 120 cm track facets in one burst: a ten-round burst that all hits is 30, so the coaxial is an anti-infantry and anti-drone weapon that wears a track down over a whole match rather than a second cannon. 2,000 rounds is the belt.
